question.text: For settlement of mutual fund units, early pay-in facility:

answer.text: Is available only for equity MF units

explanation.text: The Logic: For settlement of mutual fund units, the MF units are debited from the BO account and credited to the CC/CH house account. The early pay-in facility shall not be applicable for settlement of MF units. The Trap: 'Available only for equity MF units' is wrong — early pay-in is not applicable for any MF unit settlement. Note: The settlement flow for MF units involves a direct debit from the BO account to the CC/CH house account, without the early pay-in route used for other instruments.
